preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, m and k must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: sum(a) == m and all(0 <= a_i <= m for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: The sum of the counts of numbers must equal m, and each count must be between 0 and m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(n) + '\n' + '\n'.join(' '.join(map(str, row)) for row in matrix)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the size of the matrix n followed by the matrix itself.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_ij <= k for row in matrix for b_ij in row)
postconditions.description: All elements in the matrix must be between 0 and k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(row[i:i+2])) == 2 for row in matrix for i in range(n-1)) and all(len(set(matrix[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if (i+j)%2 == 0)) == len(set(matrix[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if (i+j)%2 == 0)) for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each 2x2 submatrix must have at most 3 occupied cells and distinct numbers on each diagonal.
